summary: Boqii Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release dated June 15, 2026, responding to unusual trading activity in its Class A ordinary shares on the NYSE American on June 10, 2026. The company states it is not aware of any material developments beyond previously disclosed information, issuing a no-news statement per NYSE American Company Guide Section 401(d). This is a routine regulatory response to unusual market action, not a special-situation event. No deal terms, strategic review, or transaction are announced, and no board recommendation or advisor is named.
